description: C# solution: a library targeting net8.0 and net10.0 with TreatWarningsAsErrors, a test project, Roslyn findings (SDK rules, Roslynator and the bundled SonarAnalyzer.CSharp), one suppressed finding, one duplicated method, Cobertura coverage

notes.findings: a probe build with SDK 10.0.401 inside the hook produced these 8 in each of the net8.0 and net10.0 logs (16 results); the report must hold each once (ruling D5). findingsExhaustive is false because a newer SDK in the 10.0 band may add rules (D13)
notes.roslyn:CA1822#suppressed: Pricing.Zero (line 26) is flagged by CA1822 inside #pragma warning disable; the log marks it suppressions:[{kind:inSource}] and it must not appear
notes.roslyn:*#quality: rule properties.category: CA5351 Security -> security; CA2000 Reliability -> reliability; CA1062 Design, CA1845 and CA1850 Performance, RCS1118 Roslynator -> maintainability
notes.roslyn:*#severity: result.level warning -> medium; RCS1118 level note -> low
notes.roslyn:S*#findings: Phase 8A/8B Task 5: the same build with the bundled SonarAnalyzer.CSharp 9.32.0.97167 (config.md §6.1) added, run in qualor/scanner-dotnet:8ab-t4 (built at commit 6703cd1) on 2026-09-29, produced S2325, S2930 and S3400 in each of the net8.0 and net10.0 logs (462 Sonar rules loaded, only SonarWay-tagged ones enabled); mergeRoslynLogs deduplicates the two frameworks' identical results down to one each
notes.roslyn:S*#quality: the SonarQube category mapping (report-format.md §7.1): properties.category is the real value the bundled analyzer wrote, '<Severity> <Type>' — S2325 'Minor Code Smell', S3400 'Minor Code Smell' -> maintainability; S2930 'Blocker Bug' -> reliability. Note: S2930's real category is 'Blocker Bug', not 'Major Bug' as an earlier probe note (task-5-brief.md) said; report-format.md §7.1 itself already uses 'a Blocker Bug stays blocker' as its worked example
notes.roslyn:S*#severity: quality/kind/severity for a rule with a SonarQube category all come from that category, never from result.level (report-format.md §7.1): Minor -> low (S2325, S3400); Blocker -> blocker (S2930), even though SonarAnalyzer reports both at SARIF level 'warning'
notes.src/Acme.Store/Pricing.cs#functions: Calls (expression-bodied property), Discount, Zero -> 3 (the field is not a function)
notes.src/Acme.Store/Pricing.cs#cognitiveCompl: if +1 (nesting 0), the && run +1, else if +1 (hybrid, no nesting); no plain else -> 3
notes.src/Acme.Store/Names.cs#functions: Describe and Count (expression-bodied property); the const field is not a function -> 2
notes.src/Acme.Store/Names.cs#complexity: Describe 1 + if + foreach + inner if = 4; Count 1 -> 5
notes.src/Acme.Store/Reader.cs#complexity: one method; ?? is not a decision (report-format §6) -> 1
notes.duplications: Names.cs 7-27 and Labels.cs 8-28 are the Describe method, identical line for line (diff); the lines before (Limit vs Width) and after (Count vs Size) differ, so the block is exactly the method: 21 lines, well over 100 tokens
notes.coverage: 7 line entries for Pricing.cs (12,13,14,16,18,20,22), hits 0 on 18 and 20 -> uncovered 2; line 14 condition-coverage 2/4 -> conditions_to_cover 4, uncovered 2; coverage = ((7-2)+(4-2))/(7+4)*100 = 63.636... -> 63.6
